description: Mirrors Tax Withholding Rate field for field (FRD v3.0, Sheet 8).

fields.label: From Date
fields.description: Rate applies to invoices posted on or after this date

fields.label: To Date
fields.description: Rate applies to invoices posted on or before this date

fields.label: Single Transaction Threshold
fields.description: TCS applies once a single invoice exceeds this. 0 means no single threshold

fields.label: Cumulative Transaction Threshold
fields.description: TCS applies once transactions with this supplier in the financial year exceed this. 0 means no cumulative threshold
